minutes.headline: Commission approved two Lancaster Ave/Goodridge fill and driveway filings and an amended delineation for 400 Lumus Shirley Road.
minutes.summary: The Conservation Commission heard several wetlands hearings. It continued four of them to February 5th (the farm-field violation at 1168 Mass Ave, 32 Hemlock Drive, 352 Sunset Lane and 67 Island Road). It approved restoration at 828 Lancaster Ave with special conditions and a gravel driveway at 157 Goodridge (4-2), and it approved an amended order of resource area delineation at 400 Lumus Shirley Road. It also approved a tree removal at 44 Brook View Terrace and voted not to pursue a paint stewardship program. Enforcement updates and a possible conservation fee increase were also discussed.

budget_items.what_was_said: North County Land Trust asked each participating town to contribute toward the workshop. The commission did not vote and said a decision would be needed within about a month.

budget_items.topic: Wetlands filing fee schedule and office consultant
budget_items.what_was_said: The chair asked the administrator to study raising fees that have not increased in a long time, in order to fund a consultant for the office. A warrant article is due next week and the process for changing fees is unresolved.
The chair reviewed the budget and had no questions.

decisions.decision: The commission asked the 1168 Mass Ave representative to consult farm-plan resources and report back by February 5th.
The applicant's engineer at 32 Hemlock Drive will revise the outlet dimensions and riprap, moving it farther from the lake.
The 352 Sunset Lane plan is to add erosion control, the walkway extent, wall length, and tree changes. Two trees would be removed and one pruned.
The 67 Island Road owner is to provide photos of the earlier walkway, measurements from the high water mark, and the stairs on the plan.
The applicant will submit a revised plan of record for 400 Lumus Shirley Road without the D series wetland.
The commission accepted the applicant's timeline for 10 Mass Ave (wetland delineation likely by the first April meeting) with no vote.
The commission will vote on the tree site visit form at the February 5th routine meeting.
Jeff expects to deliver redlines of the Hollis custodial agreement by the second February meeting.

what_happened.line: The Commission approved a gravel driveway at 157 Goodridge by a 4-2 vote.
It approved restoration at 828 Lancaster Ave with special conditions, including a survival requirement for the plantings and clean replacement fill; one member voted no.
It approved an amended order of resource area delineation at 400 Lumus Shirley Road, and a revised plan of record is to be submitted.
Four matters were continued to February 5th: the 1168 Mass Ave violation, 32 Hemlock Drive, 352 Sunset Lane and 67 Island Road.
The chair asked the administrator to study raising wetlands filing fees to fund an office consultant, and the Commission voted not to pursue a paint stewardship program.

why_it_matters: Wetlands filing fees fund part of what the Commission can do, and a fee change would reach anyone filing for work near wetlands or a lake.
Neighbors of the continued filings, including Hemlock Drive, Sunset Lane and Island Road, will see those decisions made at later meetings, not this one.
A request to co-sponsor a landowner workshop was heard without a vote, so any town contribution is still undecided.
watch_next: February 5th: the four continued hearings return, and the Commission votes on the tree site visit form.
February 19th: the 390 Howard Street delineation returns; a decision on the workshop co-sponsorship was said to be needed within about a month.
